**Technical owners.** 4 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Constitutional Alignment: Agency, Dignity, and Corrigibility](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/constitutional-alignment-substrate.html), [Inner Alignment, Mesa-Optimization, and Learned-Objective Integrity](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/inner-alignment-mesa-optimization-and-learned-objective-integrity.html), [Moral Uncertainty, Value Conflict, and Contestable Governance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/moral-uncertainty-and-value-conflict.html), [Governed Objective Formation, Value Learning, and Goal Integrity](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/governed-objective-formation-value-learning-and-goal-integrity.html).
